name: Desktop notifications
description: Shows your computer's own notifications when a bot messages you, needs your OK or has a question, while Clover is not in front. They say who and what happened, never what was said.

description.en: An approval or a question waiting for your answer.
An agent a bot started has finished its work.
A routine that ran on its own didn't finish.
Let your computer play its notification sound. Off, the banners show silently.
